name: Kodaka Hatsumi
source: A girl who ran away from her home after a fight with her parents and after her money started running out, she met and asked [url=/c68296]Kouichi[/url] to let her live with him. Hatsumi is a first-year student who attends the same school as [url=/c68287]Mari[/url] and [url=/c68288]Natsumi[/url]. A selfish liar who does her best to keep her circumstances a secret from Koichi.
